_note: 104 keys, ALL of them LLM drafts. NONE has been checked by a native Bengali speaker, which is why _reviewed is empty. Same pipeline and same rule as or.json: draft -> native speaker review -> move the key into _reviewed, and never promote a key without that review. Every string here is SPOKEN to someone who cannot read it, so a confidently wrong instruction is worse than an English one. Keys absent from this file fall through to English AND ARE SPOKEN IN AN ENGLISH VOICE — resolve() in i18n/index.ts guarantees that, so a missing key degrades honestly rather than becoming English words mangled by a Bengali TTS engine. The 145 keys not drafted here are the ones outside the photo-to-listing path (publish, setup, settings, money, orders, GST); they are next, not forgotten.
